newsitem.title: USA: Catalina to shut plant, post $3 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: Catalina to shut plant, post $3 mln charge.

text.p: Catalina Lighting Inc said Wednesday it will cease manufacturing operations at its Meridian, Mississippi facility before September 30.

The company said it expects to report a pretax charge against earnings, excluding the operating loss incurred by Meridian during the current quarter, of approximately $3 million for these discontinued operations for the quarter ending March 31.
The company added that it will continue manufacturing at Meridian for a short period of time, but that it expects to cease production as soon as possible and to sell the facility within a year.
The company added that the estimate of the pretax charge could be affected by the actual price realized on the sale of the business and/or related assets.
It recorded pretax losses from Meridian of $571,000 for the quarter ended December 31, and $2.4 million and $1.8 million for the years ended September 30, 1996 and 1995, respectively.
Catalina Lighting is a manufacturer and distributor of products for the residential and office lighting industry.
